answer: Continuous physical-presence beacon: each agent must relay a live radio challenge from a fixed summit transmitter through a copper-shielded enclosure that blocks replay, returning a fresh nonce within the local gale-measured propagation window. Enforcement: identities failing two consecutive rounds are revoked. Cost: an attacker needs one geographically distributed, always-powered relay per identity, making each fake identity cost hardware, a site lease, and continuous power—roughly the price of a real agent.
